subject_line: An Author Spotlight for All the Hidden Pieces
email_body:
Hi Dana,

Warmest wishes on the August 2026 release of All the Hidden Pieces. A story of four lifelong friends hiking the entire Appalachian Trail is a real change of pace from your Lexie Montgomery FBI thrillers, and a launch at the Pat Conroy Literary Center sounds lovely.

I would love to invite you to be featured in an Author Spotlight on The Author Ledger. The feature is designed to introduce readers to your work, the story behind your book, and the experiences or ideas that have shaped your journey as an author. Alongside our editorial features, we also support authors with professionally produced audiobook editions, cinematic book trailers, short promotional reels, author websites, press kits, Amazon A+ graphics, and book relaunch materials.

If a short cinematic trailer or a few promotional reels for All the Hidden Pieces is something you have been considering, we can handle the full production. This is entirely optional and sits alongside the Spotlight.

The Author Spotlight is a paid feature, and I would be happy to share the details and pricing if it sounds like a good fit.

Would you be interested in hearing more about the feature and the option I believe would suit All the Hidden Pieces best?

Warm regards,
Oseni Ibrahim
The Author Ledger
